name: ANARCHY SURVIVAL 26.2
description: Anarchy is a vanilla Minecraft server running since 23rd of June 2024, offering the ultimate freedom to play Minecraft as the developers intended. With no gameplay-altering plugins, no teleportation, no player homes and no pre-set economy. Every decision is yours to make. Griefing and raiding are allowed and there are no grief-prevention measures—just pure, unfiltered survival experience. The world is yours to shape, conquer or destroy.
